source.author: verg
source.text: Hic, quos durus amor crudeli tabe peredit, secreti celant calles et myrtea circum silva tegit; curae non ipsa in morte relinquunt.
source.text_original: Hic, quos durus amor crudeli tabe peredit, / secreti celant calles et myrtea circum / silva tegit; curae non ipsa in morte relinquunt.
source.text_english: Here, those whom harsh love has wasted away with cruel wasting hide in secret paths, and a myrtle grove covers them all around; their cares do not leave them even in death itself.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_original: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum / secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_english: Go, you are mine; already the dutiful band of the silent summons you to the groves, and Father Aeolus, flying about, calls you to the hidden fields.
